messages:
zoe: Starting Solarflare onboarding (solarflare-lora@0.5) into staging. Scope: token-map check, invoice CSV aggregation, 80-conv behavioral mini-eval, int4-calibrated vs int8, and a short int3 probe. Tagging @pranav for quant runs and @lucy for tokenizer locale quirks. ETA ~90m.

pranav: Got the eval pack. gs://redwood-evals/solarflare/mini-2026-03-25.tar.gz (80 convs, 30 CSV receipts, 20 currency edge-cases). Will run token diff then baseline.

lucy: FYI Solarflare has a hybrid tokenizer (custom merges for invoice tokens) and a soft-prefix that encodes CSV headers. Watch for INVNO / ORD# variants.

zoe: Token diff cmd: python tools/token_map_check.py --base open-7b --adapter solarflare-lora --out /tmp/solar-tokenmap.json

eval-bot: token-check complete: remapped=8, oov=3 (INVNO, ORD#, MICROS). Artifact: gs://redwood-evals/solarflare/tokenmap.json

pranav: Patched remap for INVNO->INVOICE_NO and MICROS->MICROS_amt. Queued baseline (adapter no-quant) job=job_120999. metadata=model=solarflare-lora@0.5, base=open-7b@2026-03-18, seed=20260325

eval-bot: baseline finished: money-f1=0.982, csv-agg-accuracy=0.996, p50lat +6ms. Scheduling int4-calibrated (perchannel, calib=2048) and int8 quick.

pranav: Running int4 first. Config: quant-mode=calibrated, quant-opt=perchannel-asymm, calib-samples=2048, clamp-scale enabled. Also will run a long-thread subset with KV-cache disabled.

eval-bot: int4-calib run complete: money-f1=0.91, csv-agg-accuracy=0.87. Observed decimal/magnitude collapse on small-value rows and some CSV column-shift cases when soft-prefix present. int8 run: money-f1=0.98, csv-agg-accuracy=0.994. report: http://ci.internal/reports/solarflare/job_120999/report.html

zoe: Can you paste a couple failing examples? Need to decide if this is tokenizer, soft-prefix, or quant.

eval-bot: Top diffs (truncated):
Example A - CSV lines:
"item,qty,unit_micros
A,1,123456
B,2,50000
Total?"
  baseline: "USD 2,234.56"
  solar-int4: "USD 223.456"  (decimal/magnitude shift)
Example B - invoice prompt: "INVNO: 00021
Charge: 0.10 USD
What's total?"
  baseline: "USD 0.10"
  solar-int4: "USD 0.01" (magnitude drop)
Example C - soft-prefix interaction: baseline sums 5 lines correctly, int4 misses final line in 2/15 long receipts

lucy: Example A points to micros token scaling being mishandled by quant scales. Example B suggests soft-prefix + small-value rounding. Try increasing calib-samples and enabling per-channel symmetric scaling with bias-correction. Also run adapter baseline without soft-prefix to isolate.

pranav: Relaunching int4-highcalib job (calib=8192, quant-opt=perchannel-symm+biascorr) and a soft-prefix-free baseline. job=job_121005. Pinning seed=20260325.

eval-bot: rerun complete: int4-highcalib money-f1=0.972, csv-agg-accuracy=0.988, long-thread diffs reduced. soft-prefix-free baseline matched original baseline for numeric cases. Artifacts archived: gs://redwood-artifacts/solarflare/job_121005.tar.gz

zoe: Nice. So calibration + symmetric per-channel + bias correction fixed most issues. Recommendation: publish two artifacts: int8 (for strict numeric SLAs) and int4-highcalib (cost-optimized) with a caveat about soft-prefix interactions. Add canary routing solarflare-numeric-safe -> int8 when money-f1 < 0.95.

ops-bot: Canary route created: name=solarflare-numeric-safe -> int8-artifact, threshold=money-f1<0.95 on last-30 evals, auto-rollout disabled.

lucy: Please open ENG-ML-5120 for adapter author to review soft-prefix token scaling and add an optional pre-normalize hook for MICROS tokens. Attach failing prompts and tokenmap diff.

evel-bot: (typo) meant eval-bot: all artifacts uploaded and metadata saved.

pranav: Ticket created ENG-ML-5120. I'll also add a short note in release notes about the MICROS->MICROS_amt remap and the recommendation to prefer post-render formatting for display.

zoe: Closing loop after 12h staging bake. Thanks team :thumbsup:
